iz.f: (African-American Vernacular) third-person singular simple present indicative of be

s.g: A wrap garment that typically covers the waist and legs and is worn by men under a thobe.
A Japanese bar that also sells snacks.
(informal, marketing) A Japanese restaurant outside of Japan; used in the naming or styling of the restaurant.
(dialectal) A spark, an ember, a hot ash or cinder.
(Scotland, and archaically in England and Ireland) The letter Z; zed, zee.
(derogatory) A purported system of social credit alleged to be endemic to Indian culture that is used in Indophobic circles as an explanation for the perceived behaviour of Indians.
(informal, sometimes derogatory) A Jew or an Israeli Jew.
